adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, both `next` and `previous` compute a new `offset`, immediately `group.set("offset", offset)`, and then call `group.findMembers()` (which performs an ajax request). There is no error handling/rollback if `findMembers()` rejects, so on request failure the model’s `offset` (and thus `currentPage`/`showingFirst`/`showingLast` derived from it) can become inconsistent with the displayed `members` list, producing incorrect pagination state.
